segments.name: Platform
segments.description: Provides subscriptions to Cricut Access and à la carte digital images, fonts, templates and projects to crafters using the cloud-based Cricut Design Space app.
segments.evidence: We generate Platform revenue primarily from sales of subscriptions to Cricut Access and Cricut Access Premium, digital content, and a minimal amount of revenue allocated to the unspecified future upgrades and enhancements related to the essential software and access to our cloud-based services.

segments.name: Products
segments.description: Designs, markets and distributes connected cutting machines, heat presses, hand tools, blades and craft materials such as vinyl to consumers and retail partners.
segments.evidence: Our connected machines portfolio consists of machines in four product families: Cricut Maker, which includes Maker, Maker 3 and Maker 4; Cricut Explore, which includes Explore Air 2, Explore 3 and Explore 4; Cricut Joy, which includes Joy and Joy Xtra; and Cricut Venture.

revenueModel.text: Consumers and retail partners pay for connected machines, Cricut Access subscriptions, accessories and materials, and à la carte digital content.
revenueModel.evidence: The revenue generated from the sales of our connected machines, subscriptions, accessories, and materials comes from a robust mix of brick-and-mortar and online retail, including direct-to-consumer on Cricut.com, and partners like Amazon, Best Buy, Costco, Hobby Lobby, HSN, Michaels, Target, and Walmart.
